author: GameTrailers
description:
Take control of a talkative little Cubit, who knows he lives inside a game, and do your best to ensure both of you survive in this harsh, unforgiving world.

Head over to Steam and add Cubits to your Wishlist.
title: Cubits - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Realpolitiks II is a real-time strategy game set in the modern world, featuring three distinct campaigns. The title belongs to the grand strategy genre, where players manage an entire country. Players can lead one of over 200 modern countries, choosing any strategy on the path to world domination. Gameplay focuses on economy, diplomacy, warfare, and technological development. Realpolitiks II also stands out for its high level of accessibility, even for new players.
Realpolitiks II will be available on Xbox Series X|S on March 19, 2026.
title: Realpolitiks II - Official Xbox Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Fangstorm, a first-person action hack-and-slash tower defense game developed by Jamie Janas. Players will become the defense in a tower defense game as a bruting ressurected demigod, taking on waves of enemies. Acquire upgrades, deploy traps against goblins, and make use of powerful abilities to keep the pressure high. Fangstorm is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Fangstorm - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Official Trailer for Cyberpunk 2077: Chrome Rush, a physical arcade combat racer developed by UNIS Games. Players can bob and weave through traffic and explore Night City right from the arcade. Take on chooms with an array of guns, melee weapons, and more across the neon-lit streets of Night City. Become a Night City Legend once and for all across 4 tracks, 8 bikes, 7 characters, and more. Cyberpunk 2077: Chrome Rush is shipping soon from UNIS Games.
title: Cyberpunk 2077: Chrome Rush - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the Dark Scrolls announcement trailer for this upcoming co-op dungeon scrolling game from developer Doinksoft (creators of Gato Roboto, Gunbrella, and Demon Throttle). Dark Scrolls combines shmup-like chaos with roguelike progression. Dark Scrolls will be available on PC and Nintendo Switch in 2026.

In Dark Scrolls, set forth on your quest to with one of the worthy yet quirky heroes in solo or cooperative play locally and online. Hack, slash and dodge through hordes of enemies and deadly traps in procedurally generated runs of hand-crafted rooms and levels using each hero's unique attacks and abilities to your advantage.
title: Dark Scrolls - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at gameplay from Beatrix in this trailer for the upcoming roguelite board-builder game. Beatrix will be available on PC in 2026, and a demo is out now on Steam.

Inspired by the spatial logic play, Beatrix transforms traditional deckbuilding into a deep board-build experience played across a shifting battlefield. As the enigmatic Beatrix, players descend through the Circles of Hell to uncover a rotting anomaly threatening the Abyss itself. By deploying Canons, powerful field effects that rewrite the rules of the grid, and mastering positional combat, every move can reshape the board and turn the tide of battle.

Will you restore balance to the underworld, or be consumed by the corruption spreading through its frozen heart?
title: Beatrix - Official Demo Trailer

Players will take on the wild frontiers of the West to dispatch enemies, establish a ranch of operations, and become a legend. The Legend of California will be playable during the Alpha Playtest from March 26 through March 30 on PC. Sign up for the Alpha Playtest now for The Legend of California, coming soon to PC (Steam).

Sign up for The Legend of California Alpha Playtest here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2550530/The_Legend_of_California/
title: The Legend of California - Official Alpha Playtest Sign Up Trailer

description:

Players will enter the fight in the close-quarters combat-focused map of Hagental Base and take to the shadows with Hagental Base: Nightfall. Become armed with new weaponry such as the CZ3A1 SMG and the fully automatic vz. 61 sidearm, alongside riding into the heat of battle with the M1030-M1 and TM/O 450 Dirt Bikes. New additions to REDSEC are also coming with new locales to the map, offering high-stakes close-quarters combat and higher rarity loot. Season 2 of Battlefield 6 is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

#Battlefield6 #Gaming #IGN

Defend the embers of hope in The Ember Guardian. Recruit and command workers to gather resources, build your camp and set up your defenses during the day. When night falls, fend off waves of deadly creatures with powerful, upgradable weapons. The Ember Guardian will be available on Steam on April 17, 2026.

Start counting the days until you can make your way to paradise – and then clean it up – in Restore Your Island, a cozy first-person cleaning sim in which you restore the natural beauty of an island by picking up all the trash (and yes, you can play with the dog in the process). Restore Your Island will be released on Steam on April 9.

description:
Containment has failed, and the nightmare is only getting worse. Watch the SCP: Fragmented Minds chapter 2 trailer for the survival horror game. Chapter 2 of SCP: Fragmented Minds will be available on Steam on April 3, 2026.

Chapter 2 of SCP: Fragmented Minds pushes players deeper into the fractured facility, greatly expanding core systems and new SCP entities that test both nerve and survival instincts, while the twists and turns of the growing story further develop the iconic SCP universe.
title: SCP: Fragmented Minds - Official Chapter 2 Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
In Their Shoes is out now on Steam. Check out the In Their Shoes launch trailer for this mumblecore narrative game. From the first day of spring, to the last day of winter, wear seven shoes of seven characters and live their most intimate moments. Explore their thoughts, choose their steps and shape their paths in a mumblecore narrative game where the most extraordinary setting is ordinary life itself.

#InTheirShoes #Gaming #IGN
title: In Their Shoes - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Overthrown leaves early access and version 1.0 is out now on PC, Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5). Watch the Overthrown version 1.0 launch trailer for this city builder game with up to 6-player co-op. The Airship Update is also available today, March 18, 2026. 

The Airship Update features the ability for players to construct and command their own airships. Players can send them to assault outlaw camps from above. However, airships come at a cost, requiring significant mana upkeep to operate, forcing players to balance power with sustainability. Outlaws are not defenseless either, fielding airships of their own and turning aerial dominance into a high-stakes strategic arms race.

In Overthrown, players rule as a monarch wielding an ancient soul-stealing crown with powerful magical abilities. Set in a hostile wilderness, the game challenges players to build, defend, and expand a kingdom while fending off bandits, mutants, and increasingly complex threats, alone or with friends
title: Overthrown - Official 1.0 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the latest Riders Republic trailer to see what to expect with Season 18, which features the new Pockett bike, updated season progression, more Mass Races, tournaments and seasonal events. Season 18 of Riders Republic is available now.
title: Riders Republic: Season 18 - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Step into the black-and-white world and check out gameplay from Cat Me If You Can in this trailer for the upcoming time-travelling cat photography puzzler game. Cat Me If You Can will be available on PC, Nintendo Switch, and Xbox Series X|S in summer 2026.

In this beautifully handcrafted black-and-white world, only photographs of hidden cats can bring colour back after a mysterious event froze Earth, leaving only cats behind! Travel to different times and places, decode clues, solve puzzles, and stay sharp to seek out every furball in the game, including His Royal Fluffiness, King Purr-a-lot.
title: Cat Me If You Can - Official Gameplay & Release Window Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the 'First Look' Gameplay Video for Exodus, a sci-fi action-adventure decision-based game developed by Archetype Entertainment. Players will embark on a journey through the cosmos to lead humanity's fight against the Celestials as the Traveler. Make use of an arsenal of weapons and abilities to engage with the game's third-person action combat shooting from planet to planet. Exodus is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), with an extended gameplay look coming in Summer 2026.
title: Exodus - Official First Look Gameplay

His crew fear him, the galaxy wants him dead, and you're the one flying his ship. Solar Echoes: Star Fated will be available on PC.
title: Solar Echoes: Star Fated - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Goro Majima from Like a Dragon/Yakuza, Death Adder from Golden Axe, and Dr. Eggman from Sonic the Hedgehog are coming to Shinobi: Art of Vengeance. Watch the Shinobi: Art of Vengeance animated trailer for this action platformer game. Check it out as the ninja, Joe Musashi, confronts iconic SEGA villains! The SEGA Villains Stage DLC features three new bosses, five new stages, two new Boss Rush modes, three new ninpo, three new outfits, and six new music tracks. A free update patch will also be released on April 3 alongside the DLC, featuring a Hardcore Mode and combat system adjustments. The free update will also include updates to character outlines, map and tutorial display features.

Shinobi: Art of Vengeance is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Nintendo Switch, Xbox, and PC via Steam. The Shinobi: Art of Vengeance SEGA Villains Stage DLC will be available on April 3, 2026.
title: Shinobi: Art of Vengeance - Official SEGA Villains Stage DLC Release Date Animated Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a fresh look at Skytail in this trailer for the upcoming VR action game. Skytail will be available on Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3, Meta Quest 3s, and Meta Quest Pro on March 26, 2026.

In Skytail, you take to the skies on the back of a legendary birdlike companion and use telekinetic powers to defeat the beasts trying to hinder you and your friend’s rescue mission. Living among the clouds with your birdlike buddy, your idyllic life is shattered when corrupted fiends steal your Skytail’s offspring. Together, you must set off on an adventure to save them. It’s time to harness the telekinetic powers of the ancients to defend yourself and bring the youngsters home safely.
title: Skytail - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest Hunt: Showdown 1896 trailer to see gameplay for the Devil's Trail in-game event, which introduces game-changing scouting and tracking mechanics, a new Battle Pass with many rewards, a new fire-spitting monster, and improvements. The Devil's Trail event is available now alongside the launch of Update 2.7 on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Game Pass, and Xbox Series X/S.

Devil's Trail offers a unique tactical twist to the world of Hunt: Showdown 1896, making information the most valuable currency in the bayou and the Colorado mountains. Supply Points, Extraction Points, and new Event-exclusive Burned Convoy locations are now hidden at Mission start. Players must actively uncover them using Scout Towers scattered across the map, which contain interactive Scouting Maps that reveal hidden locations, new Tarot Cards, custom ammunition, and Traits.
title: Hunt: Showdown 1896 - Official Devil's Trail Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Zip up your hazmat suit and lather up your mop: sci-fi survival horror just got... soapy. Here's your look at the Cleaner Company trailer for this upcoming sci-fi co-op cleaning sim game. Cleaner Company will be available on PC via Steam and Epic Games Store in 2026.

In Cleaner Company, as an elite member of the Star Wipers crew, strap on your cleaning tools and gear up for a grisly cleanup of horror hotspots across the galaxy. From eerie space stations, to ruined restaurants and ominous undiscovered planets, Star Wipers are sent in to clean up the mess when things go wrong. And in the far reaches of space, business is booming...

Play together with friends in up to 4 player online co-op, embarking on interstellar expeditions to mop up monstrous messes, tackle challenges, and collect resources to upgrade your cleaning equipment.

#CleanerCompany #Gaming #IGN
title: Cleaner Company - Official Trailer

Check out the Cash is King announcement trailer for this upcoming cozy first-person simulation game that throws you into the colorful, slightly chaotic life of Miami Beach. In Cash is King, you start with empty pockets but plenty of ambition. In a relaxed, humorous simulation, you collect cash, improve your reputation, and rise step by step to become a local mini-mogul. The motto: Cash is King – and you want the crown!

After crash-landing in a strange but charming galaxy, Doug the duck sets out on a journey to gather resources, build gadgets, upgrade his spaceship, and discover that life among the stars might not be as stressful as it was quacked up to be.
